Questions

Before you call

Straight answers to what North Florida homeowners ask us most. First Coast Haul connects you with local partner crews — your estimate and the work itself are handled by the contractor matched to your job.

How much does junk hauling cost?+

It depends on how much there is and what it is, so we price it in person. Book a free on-site estimate — we look at the load, give you the price before anything is loaded, and there's no obligation if you pass.

How soon can you pick up my junk?+

Same day when we have an opening, otherwise the next day we can get there. Call or text early in the day for the best shot at a same-day estimate and pickup.

Will you take just one item?+

Yes. One couch, one mattress or one appliance is a normal job for us — you don't need a full load to book.

Do I have to move everything to the curb first?+

No. We load it from wherever it sits. Just tell us about stairs, tight doorways or a long carry when you book, and we'll plan for it at the estimate.

Do you do whole-house and estate cleanouts?+

Yes — one room, the garage, or the whole house. We handle estate, foreclosure and move-out cleanouts for families, landlords and realtors, and leave the space broom-clean.

What don't you haul?+

Paint, chemicals and fuel have to go to the county hazardous waste drop-off, so set those aside and tell us about them when you book. Just about everything else — furniture, appliances, concrete, dirt, yard and construction debris — is on our list.

What happens to the junk after you take it?+

Crews sort each load: usable furniture and goods are donated where possible, metal and other recyclables are recycled, and the rest goes to licensed local disposal facilities.

Where do you work?+

Across North Florida: Jacksonville and the Beaches, Orange Park, Fleming Island, Middleburg, Green Cove Springs, St. Augustine, Palm Coast, Palatka, Fernandina Beach, Yulee, Macclenny, Starke and Lake City. If you're nearby, text your ZIP and we'll tell you if we can get there.
